questions.title: Which of these companies will have the highest rank among their group on CompaniesMarketCap on December 28, 2026?
questions.background:
Investopedia: [Market Capitalization: What It Means for Investors](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/m/marketcapitalization.asp)

`{"format": "bot_tournament_question", "info": {"hash_id": "4f4fb6b873ed5d71", "sheet_id": "152"}}`
questions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as the option corresponding to the listed public company that has the highest rank in CompaniesMarketCap's [Largest Companies by Marketcap](https://companiesmarketcap.com/) among these five companies upon the close of regular US stock market trading on December 28, 2026: SpaceX, Meta Platforms (Facebook), Tesla, Anthropic, and Berkshire Hathaway.
questions.fine_print: No other resolution source will be used to resolve the question, and Metaculus will not second-guess CompaniesMarketCap's methodology in calculating market capitalization for any company. This question resolves strictly based on the highest rank among the companies as presented by the resolution source.
